newsitem.title: USA: Salient 3 says Q2 loss is possible.
newsitem.headline: Salient 3 says Q2 loss is possible.

text.p: Salient 3 Communications Inc said Thursday it may record a loss in the second quarter ending July 4 because of delays in new product development.

The company said prelimary results from continuing operations through the first three weeks of May indicate that it is unlikely that earnings will meet previous estimates of $0.05-$0.10 per share. The company said in a statement it is not possible to quantify the estimates so early in the quarter but that it was "possible that there could be a loss."
In the statement, company president Timothy Cobb said Salient's SAFCO unit continues to experience delays in the development of new products on which its 1997 performance was "somewhat dependent."
"Since SAFCO is a significant component of Salient 3, the revenue and earnings delays at SAFCO create uncertainty about our ability to achieve full year 1997 Salient 3 earnings estimates," Cobb said.
"We remain hopeful that many of those products will be ready by the beginning of the third quarter and that our Wireless Group in total can complete 1997 reasonably close to expectations," Cobb said.
